title: Chapter 534
paragraphs: Chapter 534
The moment the white stone is handed over, the war of Hairan would inevitably lose its meaning.
If the war was merely about handing over the white stone, Jin would not have come here in the first place.
"If the fight escalates further, I won't be able to make the same offer again with my authority. I simply want to minimize unnecessary death."

"Once Zipple and I have received support from our respective friends, this war is no longer just between the Empire and Hairan. Unnecessary death? Is there such a thing between Runcandel and Zipple? Aren't we destined to fight until one side is completely finished anyway?"
In the end, Laramakuwa had no choice but to abandon the negotiation.
"You will regret it."
"The conversation is over, return to your ranks. Don't unnecessarily provoke my wrath."
In fact, Jin was not so confident to take such a strong stance.
A full-frontal confrontation with Zipple was an immense burden for Jin.
No, it was more than a burden, it was a dangerous development that felt like there was no answer yet.
Nevertheless, Jin refused to back down.
'If Zipple is talking about a full-frontal confrontation with Runcandel... it makes me rethink how important the white stone is.'
The white stone.
If that cursed object, which is tarnishing my friend's family and pride, is truly something that Zipple must obtain, even if it means going through a full-frontal confrontation with Runcandel.
I must never back down. Jin was not holding out because he wanted to, but because he had no other choice.

It was no longer just about the Sword Emperor City. If the white stone is a valuable object, Zipple will definitely use it to leap a step further. And it was Runcandel's greatest mission to stop Zipple.
Of course, it's not like he didn't have any doubts.
'My mother and the top-notch members of the family will surely be watching the situation.'
The emperor has revealed the existence of the white stone to the world, and Zipple sent reinforcements, even revealing their mass production fleet.
There's no way Runcandel could remain inactive in the face of such a massive event.
'My mother probably hasn't been able to assess the value of the white stone yet, so she decided to wait and see. But if Zipple shows a full-scale approach, the family will also step in. Definitely.'
The same went for Talaris.
She is currently observing the battle as a bystander, but the moment she concludes that the white stone threatens the world in some form, she would join the fight.
As long as Ron and Dante do not use the white stone as a means of defense, her sword will be directed towards Zipple.

'I don't know about Ron, who's unconscious, but Dante will never make that choice. Even if he harbors extreme emotions, I can stop him. If I can stop that, there's no need for Lady Talaris to pressure the Sword Emperor City.'
Jin had heard about Ron's condition from the knights of Hairan on the way forward.
Thinking about what Dante might be going through while keeping Ron, who is still unconscious, in the Sword Emperor City, made his heart ache once more.
'Veradin.'
At the same time, another friend came to mind.
'I believe you're doing something for Dante, too.'
If he was in his right mind, he definitely would be.
Jin hoped that Veradin would not become a war puppet to attack Hairan as he did on the mission to assassinate Barton. It would be too cruel for everyone.
Laramakua turned around abruptly and transformed back into her original form.
As soon as she settled back into the sky, the battle resumed.
The brief respite just moments ago seemed a complete farce as the battlefield was instantly filled with screams and explosive sounds.
Most of the screams were from Zipple's magicians and dragons, and the explosive sounds were from their fleets breaking apart.
The power of the five Sword Saints, including Murakan, stood out especially.
Unlike Dante, they possessed a strong body, so they cut off the enemies' breath by firing their Qi endlessly.
The bright Qi, including Heavenly Sword, lit up the night sky, and occasionally Jin's Thunder Qi showed its majesty.

The Emperor's ground forces could no longer tighten their encirclement. Amela's artillery support did not stop, and in the rear, Jin's companions, including the Valkas and the Proch siblings, were still active.
The early and mid-stages of the battle were going in favor of the Sword Emperor's side.
However, those fighting for Hairan were not elated. Rather, as the tide turned in their favor, they prepared for the next fight with an even more resolute attitude.
This couldn't be the end.

The first wave of Zipple's reinforcements had significantly reduced in size. There were only about five frigates left, and most of the magicians and dragons had been killed. The remaining seemed likely to share their fate within minutes.
Cheongryong Laramakua, the leader, also lost one wing and was barely roaring.
'At this point... it seems done.'
Laramakua thought. There was one thing that neither the imperial army nor the knights gathered for Hairan knew.
In anticipation of such a situation, Zipple had prepared a measure by grafting an incomplete technology and ancient dark magic.
Suddenly, the blood flowing from Laramakua drew a magic circle in the air.
Neither large nor bright, it was drawn so quickly that nobody noticed its formation in the chaotic battle.
Jin and his companions didn't notice until a few seconds after the magic circle was completed.
'What's that?'
'A blood magic circle...!?'
Murakan breathed out onto Laramakua as soon as he recognized the magic circle.
The dark breath pierced her heart, and the blood that drew the magic circle was scattered by its power.
However, the blood soon gathered again, maintaining the shape of the magic circle.
And not only was Laramakua forming the blood magic circle, but the surviving dragons of Zipple and commander-level wizards were also drawing the same magic circle with their blood.
What their magic circles were using as a catalyst was death itself, which had been constantly blooming throughout the battlefield.
Kiiiiiiik...!
The blood magic circles resonated and produced a strange metallic sound.
Knights from the Sword Emperor's camp who could attack in mid-air continued to strike the magic circles, but the circles maintained their shape even when torn apart and combined.
Soon, the combined magic circles took the shape of a cube.
'A cube?'
Suddenly, Jin thought of the Gaipa Army Road.
The artifact Midor Elna used to summon Myron Zipple had the appearance of a perfect cube as well.
'No way.'
A space-time device.
'Was it possible to summon not only with artifacts, but also with magic...?!'
Cough!
Laramakua collapsed, vomiting blood, and her death completed the magic circle.
There was no need to shout that it was dangerous. The allies in the air had already sensed something strange and were retreating.
The magic circle began to emit a crimson light. In no time, that light, which resembled the sun of some ominous day, formed a massive dimensional gate.
The first thing to emerge from the dimensional gate was a warship, almost identical in shape to the Cojek.
Zzzzzzzzt...!
As the warship emerged, the surrounding space warped.
A tremendous force sucked in the bodies and blood that were still in the air, producing a bizarre noise.
Before the existence of mass-produced ships, the Cojek, the only warship, was known to have its performance vary depending on the passengers.
The mass-produced ships were no different. All flying warships could be merely a means of transportation or formidable weapons of war, depending on the magical power of the passengers.
The previously destroyed Zipple mass-produced ships hadn't shown any remarkable performance.
However, the newly emerged fleet had wizards of a different dimension powering them. This was evident without having to fight them.
The density of the magic power surrounding the ships was entirely different.
It was a tingling density that even knights who couldn't read magic power could feel.
'The Spirit Army.'
It was already expected that more reinforcements would come.
Summoning through dark magic had only brought the time forward, and the appearance of the Spirit Army was not surprising, as it had been known from the start.
Even so, Jin let out a hollow laugh because there were too many of them.
Thirty mass-produced ships emerged from the dimensional gate. And all those ships were operated by the Spirit Army.
'Just how many of these Spirit Armies do they have...?!'
During his reserve knight days, Jin first encountered fifteen Spirit Armies on Veradin's Island.
Back then, Jin was convinced that there would be at least twenty Spirit Armies based on the awkwardness of their chain magic.
But the ships in front of his eyes numbered more than thirty, and each one was powered by the magic of at least two Spirit Army members.
By simple calculation, this meant close to sixty, a number that was impossible without deep thought.
If they had been able to maintain that many Spirit Armies, Zipple could have easily conquered Runcandel before the era of Chiron.
So, there were two hypotheses.
'Either they have recently invented a training method that greatly surpasses the previous one, rapidly increasing the number of Spirit Armies....'
Or they have revived the dead.
It had already been proven long ago that Zipple could resurrect humans through the Marstone when fighting with Andrei Zipple.
Jin assumed it was the latter.
'The wizards who were resurrected with Myron Zipple on Gaipa Army Road... It's exactly the same as then. The scale and quality are just different.'
Kahahaha!
A familiar voice came from the first ship that appeared.
It was the voices of Midor Elna and Myron Zipple.
'It seems fate has a sense of humor, for you to be here...!'
'I, Myron Gi... have returned from hell twice!'
Before they could finish their sentences, Jin and Murakan simultaneously unleashed the Light Speed Stab and breathed.
The secret technique of Runcandel and the full power of the Black Dragon tore through the protective barrier and shattered the bow of the ship where Midor and Myron stood.
In such a futile manner, Midor and Myron met their second and third deaths, respectively.
After Jin and Murakan's power swept through the bow of the ship, only their ankles were left.
'Like cockroaches, they keep coming back even when killed. They only show up, make a pathetic spectacle, and disappear.'
Murakan sneered.
But both he and Jin knew. The idiot brothers of Zipple died because the Spirit Armies on the other ships didn't protect them.
Though they were positioned at the forefront, Myron and Midor were not their commanders.
The Spirit Armies recognized them as nobodies who had the weakest skills but only yielded their positions because they were the sons of Kelliark. It didn't matter whether they lived or died.
Therefore, even though the flagship at the forefront was damaged and Myron and Midor were killed, the Spirit Armies silently increased their magic power.
'Those guys... they'll certainly be a handful.'
Jin gritted his teeth in thought.
He hoped that the resurrected Spirit Armies wouldn't be as tough as the real ones he had first encountered.
